name: Refuge Area No. 1
rule: PBC Code App. G §§ 13-55, 13-56: no spearfishing on underwater breathing apparatus. Freediving is NOT restricted. Latitudes are exact; the 750 yd inner edge is measured from OpenStreetMap coastline data.

name: Area No. 1: inner carve-out
rule: § 13-55 excludes water inside 750 yd of MHW, and water shallower than 30 ft at MLW, from the refuge. The depth condition is NOT drawn: only the 750 yd distance.

name: Refuge Area No. 2
rule: PBC Code App. G §§ 13-55, 13-56: no spearfishing on underwater breathing apparatus. Freediving is NOT restricted. Latitudes are exact; the 750 yd inner edge is measured from OpenStreetMap coastline data.

name: Area No. 2: inner carve-out
rule: § 13-55 excludes water inside 750 yd of MHW, and water shallower than 30 ft at MLW, from the refuge. The depth condition is NOT drawn: only the 750 yd distance.

name: Atlantic beach buffer: 125 yd seaward
rule: R. 68B-20.003(2)(a): 100 yd from ALL public bathing beaches: FWC's rule says 'all', not 'designated'. Drawn at 125 yd, seaward only, along the entire developed beachfront. Named public beaches here: Palm Beach (to 26.771), Riviera Beach / Singer Island (26.774 to 26.800), Ocean Reef / MacArthur (26.800 to 26.814).

name: North jetty: 150 ft buffer
rule: Rule is 100 ft from the unsubmerged portion (R. 68B-20.003(2)(d)). Drawn at 150 ft for submerged toe stone and tide swing. Tip is chart-accurate (NOAA ENC); the landward run follows OSM breakwater geometry.

name: South jetty: 150 ft buffer
rule: Same rule and margin. Tip and root are chart-accurate.

name: Ruined L-groin: 150 ft buffer
rule: Charted as a GROIN, not a jetty, and it covers and uncovers: so the buffer arguably blinks with the tide. Treated as always-on.

name: Blue Heron Bridge: 125 yd
rule: Public fishing IS legally permitted here: Fla. Stat. § 316.1305 allows bridge fishing by default, and FDOT's Feb 2021 no-fishing signs were removed within days as installed in error. So the 100 yd bridge buffer attaches. Span geometry from OpenStreetMap. Drawn at 125 yd.

name: Phil Foster Park: 125 yd
rule: Guarded swim area, a public fishing pier (the old bridge remnant) and two fishing platforms: each an independent 100 yd buffer. Plus the R. 68B-42.0036 no-take SMLA.

name: Peanut Island swim area: 125 yd
rule: County beach and snorkel trail on the island's east side. Beach polygon from OpenStreetMap.

name: Inlet: narrow reading
rule: § 13-33: no underwater spear fishing within any inlet, ever. Narrow reading = water between the jetties, seaward limit at the COLREGS line across the tips.

name: Inlet: broad reading
rule: The throat west of the jetty roots, toward the Port turning basin. 'Inlet' is UNDEFINED in § 13-31 (confirmed by reading it). This western limit is one plausible construction, not a boundary anyone has adopted.

name: COLREGS demarcation line
rule: 33 CFR 80.727: a line across the seaward extremity of the Lake Worth Inlet jetties. The only official line drawn at this inlet.

name: Diver-flag zone: 200 yd of the jetties
rule: § 13-37: flag required in Atlantic waters within 200 yd of any portion of the jetties. Does not apply inside 150 yd of the MHW line. § 13-38 requires one anywhere more than 150 yd offshore anyway.

name: 3 nm state waters line
rule: Atlantic state waters end at 3 nm. East of this line federal snapper-grouper rules apply. Measured from the OSM coastline: approximate, and the legal baseline is not identical to the visible shoreline.

name: Idle / slow speed zone: approximate
rule: R. 68C-22.009 and R. 68D-24.017(1)(c): year-round idle speed both sides of Lake Worth from the Port turning basin to one mile south of Peanut Island, plus a shoreline-to-shoreline slow zone across Peanut Island / Blue Heron. THIS OUTLINE IS INDICATIVE ONLY: the real zone follows the lagoon shoreline and posted markers.
